title: ME60352: Robotics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Robotics
Introduction to Robotics: Definitions, motivation, historical development,
basic structure, classification, workspace, grippers, specifications
Robot Arm Kinematics and Dynamics: Frame transformation, D-H parameters,
Forward kinematics, Inverse kinematics, Lagrange formulation
Trajectory Generation: Cartesian scheme, Joint space scheme
Teaching Methods: Manual teaching, Lead-through teaching, VAL programming
Sensing: Range sensing, proximity sensing, touch sensors, force and torque
sensing
Robot Vision: Low-level vision, Higher-level vision
Control Schemes: Position control, force control, hybrid position and force
control
Motion Planning: Traditional and non-traditional techniques

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion
As a student, I have found that studying Robotics through NPTEL is far more beneficial than in a traditional classroom setting. The NPTEL platform provides access to high-quality video lectures by experienced professors from the top engineering institutions in India. These video lectures are incredibly detailed and provide a strong foundation for understanding the theoretical aspects of Robotics. 

How to Crack the Paper

Classroom resources
Completely available on NPTEL - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rYWJdZ5qg6M&list=PLbRMhDVUMngcdUbBySzyzcPiFTYWr4rV_

 Additional Resources 
Fundamentals of Robotics by DK Pratihar

Robotics by Fu, Gonzalez and Lee

Introduction to Robotics by Craig
